cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

dao/locks/Lock.title: Lock
dao/locks/Lock.description: A single lock: proposal id, unlock time (POSIX ms), and the stake committed.

dao/types/ProposalDatum.title: ProposalDatum

anyOf.title: EndProposal
anyOf.description:
Closes the poll, declaring which effect script won: `Some(hash)` executes
 the winner's bound effect (a strict winner above the `execute` threshold
 whose withdrawal must be present), `None` closes without executing. The
 proposal validator checks the declaration against the tally; candidate
 scripts verify the closure named them via `am_i_the_winner`.

dao/types/ProposalThresholds.title: ProposalThresholds
dao/types/ProposalThresholds.description:
Governance thresholds required at each stage of a proposal's lifecycle.
 All quantities are in staked-token units.

dao/types/ProposalTimingConfig.title: ProposalTimingConfig
dao/types/ProposalTimingConfig.description: Phase durations (POSIX **milliseconds**) for a proposal's lifecycle.

dao/types/ProposalTokenRedeemer.title: ProposalTokenRedeemer
dao/types/ProposalTokenRedeemer.description: Redeemer for the proposal token minting policy.

dao/types/StakeRedeemer.title: StakeRedeemer
dao/types/StakeRedeemer.description: Actions on a stake position UTxO.

dao/types/StakeTokenRedeemer.title: StakeTokenRedeemer
dao/types/StakeTokenRedeemer.description: Redeemer for the stake position NFT minting policy.

dao/types/VoteRedeemer.title: VoteRedeemer
dao/types/VoteRedeemer.description: Actions on a vote artifact UTxO.

anyOf.title: TallyVote
anyOf.description:
Tally the vote for the associated proposal. The `out_idx` specifies the
 index of the output where the refunded minUTxO should be sent.

dao/types/VoteTokenRedeemer.title: VoteTokenRedeemer
dao/types/VoteTokenRedeemer.description: Redeemer for the vote NFT minting policy.

event_triggered/types/CouponParams.title: CouponParams
event_triggered/types/CouponParams.description:
Compile-time parameters of one vault's coupon policy (§4.4, §4.5, §4.6,
 §4.7). The policy is a plain native mint policy outside the issuance
 dependency cone, so it bakes the governed `cip_policy` directly.

fields.title: cip_policy
fields.description:
The bond's governed policy — the certificate asset the claim anchor
 reads.

fields.title: principal
fields.description: The unit principal, in lovelace — the name of the graduation coupon.

fields.title: interval
fields.description:
The constant number of lovelace-seconds between steps: step `k` opens
 at `start + k * interval`.

fields.title: amounts
fields.description: The per-step coupon amounts; `length(amounts)` is the final step `N`.

event_triggered/types/MintingAction.title: MintingAction
event_triggered/types/MintingAction.description:
Mode redeemer on the minting-logic withdraw-0. The minting credential is
 also the registration authority, so it runs in four contexts and must be
 told why (09-DEVELOPING-MODULES, "Your issuance logic must know why it is
 running"). Each mode is cross-checked against the transaction shape in
 `issuance.validate` (§4.1, §4.2, §4.5, §4.7).

anyOf.title: Register
anyOf.description:
Register only (§4.1): inserts the instrument's RegistryNode. No
 certificate is minted, so the same registration serves every deposit.

anyOf.title: Deposit
anyOf.description:
Permissionless unit deposit (§4.2): mints one step-`0` certificate when
 the chosen vault gains exactly the unit `principal`.

anyOf.title: Advance
anyOf.description:
Coupon claim (§4.5): burns the certificate's current name, mints the
 next and requires the step's coupon under the certificate's `cnt_policy`.

anyOf.title: Retire
anyOf.description:
Certificate retirement (§4.7): burns the final name and requires the
 principal coupon under the certificate's `cnt_policy`.

event_triggered/types/MintingParams.title: MintingParams
event_triggered/types/MintingParams.description:
Compile-time parameters of the minting-logic validator (§4.1, §4.2, §4.5,
 §4.7). Deliberately NO policy id here: the governed policy id is a hash
 *of* this script's applied form, so parameterizing it with the id would be
 circular — the validator resolves it at runtime from the registry node
 instead. The module is schedule-agnostic: coupon terms live in each vault's
 coupon policy, and the certificate's `cnt_policy` selects them.

fields.title: registry_node_cs
fields.description:
Policy of the core registry's node NFTs; locates the instrument's
 `RegistryNode` and pins its shape.

fields.title: issuer
fields.description:
Registration authority: the issuer signs the registration and the
 issuer-triggered paths (§4.1, §4.5, §4.7).

fields.title: transfer_logic
fields.description:
Frozen at registration: the name-monotone transfer logic — the node's
 stance is pinned to it.

fields.title: third_party_logic
fields.description:
Frozen at registration: the issuer-triggered third-party logic — the
 node's stance is pinned to it.

fields.title: vault
fields.description:
The vault script hash. The deposit mode locates the chosen vault UTxO
 by this payment credential and checks the pair's net ADA gain (I6).

fields.title: vault_nft_cs
fields.description:
The vault NFT policy. Every vault UTxO carries exactly one unit under
 this policy (I10); the deposit requires it, so a fake output at the
 vault address can never back a certificate.

fields.title: principal
fields.description:
The unit principal, in lovelace. Each deposit must add exactly this to
 the chosen vault (I6).

event_triggered/types/Payout.title: Payout
event_triggered/types/Payout.description: One payout the redeemer names on a redemption (§4.6).

event_triggered/types/ThirdPartyAction.title: ThirdPartyAction
event_triggered/types/ThirdPartyAction.description:
Redeemer of the third-party-logic withdraw-0 — the opt-in issuer trigger
 (§4.5, §4.7). Typed for the builders' convenience; the logic is structural.

event_triggered/types/ThirdPartyParams.title: ThirdPartyParams
event_triggered/types/ThirdPartyParams.description: Compile-time parameters of the issuer-triggered third-party-logic validator.

event_triggered/types/TransferAction.title: TransferAction
event_triggered/types/TransferAction.description:
Redeemer of the transfer-logic withdraw-0. The name-monotone rule is
 enforced structurally (§4.3); the redeemer is typed for the builders'
 convenience.

event_triggered/types/TransferParams.title: TransferParams
event_triggered/types/TransferParams.description:
Compile-time parameters of the transfer-logic validator. The governed
 policy id is resolved at runtime from the referenced registry node.

event_triggered/types/VaultAction.title: VaultAction
event_triggered/types/VaultAction.description: Redeemer of the vault spend validator (§3.1, §4.2, §4.6).

anyOf.title: VaultDeposit
anyOf.description: Unit deposit (§4.2): the vault gains exactly the baked `principal`.

anyOf.title: Redeem
anyOf.description:
Burn-to-pay redemption (§4.6): the vault loses exactly the sum decoded
 from the burned coupon names, paid to the named addresses.

anyOf.title: VaultTopUp

event_triggered/types/VaultDatum.title: VaultDatum
event_triggered/types/VaultDatum.description:
Inline datum of a vault (§3.1): binds the coupon policy whose negative
 mints the `Redeem` path honors. The vault owner lives off-chain — custody
 is the instrument's central assumption (§7), not a datum field.

event_triggered/types/VaultNftParams.title: VaultNftParams
event_triggered/types/VaultNftParams.description:
Compile-time parameters of the vault NFT policy (§3.1, I10). The vault is
 authenticated by exactly one NFT under this policy, minted by `authority`
 when the vault is created (creation is out of scope).

event_triggered/types/VaultParams.title: VaultParams
event_triggered/types/VaultParams.description:
Compile-time parameters of the vault validator (§3.1, §4.2, §4.6). The
 coupon policy is read from the vault datum, so it is not a constant here.

anyOf.title: VaultParams
anyOf.description: The unit principal a deposit must add to the vault (§4.2).

fields.title: vault_nft_cs
fields.description: The vault NFT policy every vault UTxO must carry (I10).

settings/types/MintRedeemer.title: MintRedeemer
settings/types/MintRedeemer.description: Redeemer for the mint endpoint of the settings validator.

settings/types/SettingsDatum.title: SettingsDatum
settings/types/SettingsDatum.description:
A configurable governance setting with a delayed-apply pattern.

 `current` is the active value. `next` is a proposed new value
 that, if present alongside `next_apply`, can be committed after
 the specified time.

settings/types/SpendRedeemer.title: SpendRedeemer
settings/types/SpendRedeemer.description: Redeemer for the spend endpoint of the settings validator.

smart_wallet/types/MintRedeemer.title: MintRedeemer
smart_wallet/types/MintRedeemer.description: Actions on the mint endpoint: create or close a wallet, one-shot.

anyOf.title: Mint
anyOf.description: Mint the wallet NFT; `out_ix` locates the new wallet UTxO.

anyOf.title: Burn
anyOf.description: Burn the wallet NFT, permanently closing the wallet.

smart_wallet/types/SpendRedeemer.title: SpendRedeemer
smart_wallet/types/SpendRedeemer.description: Actions on a wallet UTxO (spend endpoint).

anyOf.title: Spend
anyOf.description:
Pay out: base M-of-N floor plus the delegated spenders; the wallet must
 survive with its `depositors` map unchanged and without gaining value.

anyOf.title: UpdatePermissions
anyOf.description:
Rewrite this UTxO's config (`spenders` and `depositors`); `out_ix`
 locates the continuation.

anyOf.title: Deposit
anyOf.description:
Deposit funds: every `depositors` script runs and approves, funds are
 added, `spenders` and the `depositors` key set are preserved, and each
 deposit script may advance its own `Data`; `out_ix` locates the
 continuation.

anyOf.title: Close
anyOf.description: Close the wallet: the `admin` authorizes, and the wallet NFT is burned.

smart_wallet/types/WalletDatum.title: WalletDatum
smart_wallet/types/WalletDatum.description:
Datum carried by each wallet UTxO: the delegated authorization scripts for
 spends and deposits. The credential allowed to update them is a parameter of
 the spending script.

fields.title: spenders
fields.description:
Delegated withdraw-0 scripts that must run on every spend of this UTxO,
 each carrying its own mutable data (if any) in `Data`.

fields.title: depositors
fields.description:
Delegated withdraw-0 scripts that must run on every deposit into this
 UTxO (e.g. asset or source-address allow/denylists, or deposit caps), each
 carrying its own configuration or mutable state in `Data`.

upgradeability/counter/CounterDatum.title: CounterDatum
upgradeability/counter/CounterDatum.description:
State of the demo counter used to exercise the upgradeability pattern end to
 end.

 - `count` is the counter value.
 - `owner` gates the opt-in `Upgrade` path (per-UTxO consent).
 - `prev_input` binds a continuation output to the UTxO it continues (`None`
   only at the genesis lock). Every validation matches its continuation by
   the `OutputReference` it claims, so several UTxOs can be settled in one
   transaction without one continuation swallowing another: a single output
   can only satisfy the single input it names.

upgradeability/counter/CounterRedeemer.title: CounterRedeemer
upgradeability/counter/CounterRedeemer.description:
Actions accepted by the counter demo.

 `Tick` is the ordinary counter step, accepted by the forced logic and by
 both opt-in versions. `Upgrade` is the dedicated migration path, accepted
 only by the opt-in V1 validator.

vesting/types/VestedAsset.title: VestedAsset
vesting/types/VestedAsset.description:
One asset in a vesting bundle, paired with the **original** total quantity
 that the schedule releases over its lifetime.

vesting/types/VestingDatum.title: VestingDatum
vesting/types/VestingDatum.description:
Immutable vesting state. Written once at lock time; every continuing output
 must reproduce it verbatim. Times are POSIX **milliseconds**.

fields.title: beneficiary
fields.description: Who may claim. A key authorizes by signing; a script by being invoked.

fields.title: locker
fields.description:
Who may recover the remainder after `recovery_time`. Same pluggable
 credential mechanism as `beneficiary`.

fields.title: vesting
fields.description: The original locked bundle and per-asset totals.

fields.title: recovery_time
fields.description:
After this time the `locker` may recover whatever remains. Must be
 strictly after `end_time` (enforced on cancel).

anyOf.title: Claim
anyOf.description: Beneficiary withdraws up to the currently-vested amount.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Locker recovers the remainder once `recovery_time` has passed.
